scope: Closes the open point of UI-ENGINE-BOAS-VINDAS-20261103: the boas-vindas template left a tab in the Notepad session at each run.
cause: The end of the run closed the window with WM_CLOSE. Notepad keeps each saved tab of a window closed that way and brings it back at the next start.
change: The template declares close_by notepad_tab. The saved tab of the run is closed with Ctrl+W, by the rules of the close step, before what is left of the window. Tabs of a restored session stay in the session; a tab this run did not open keeps the window open. A failure to close is reported in opened_app and does not change the verified result.

environment.session: interactive session of the station user, computer idle

acceptance.via: Runner source on D: with the lab Python and the Engine of the installed build, real Notepad, output in a lab folder

scenarios.clean: Verified, app closed, no window left, no tab for the next start.
scenarios.restored: A synthetic tab kept by the session: verified, app closed, the session holds only that tab, reopened with its text intact.

gate.result: 3 idle and 3 full-load trials: verified, app closed, no window left, session_tabs_added 0. The smoke now fails a trial that adds a session tab.

checks.command: cd tests/runtime && python -B -m unittest test_notepad_steps test_templates test_runner test_browser_open test_excel
cd tests/core && python -B -m unittest test_browser_processes, test_core, test_agent, test_identity, each in its own process

not_exercised: The case of a tab opened by another program during the run is covered by component tests only.
A run with Notepad already open keeps its window and tab, as the template's end state says; not changed here.
installed: 0.1.0-beta.22 remains installed; beta.23 was not installed, signed or published.
